question_en: A $2\times2$ matrix has trace $5$ and determinant $6$. What are its eigenvalues?
question_uz: $2\times2$ matritsaning izi $5$ ga, determinanti $6$ ga teng. Uning xos qiymatlari qaysi?
question_ru: След матрицы $2\times2$ равен $5$, определитель равен $6$. Каковы её собственные значения?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. λ₁+λ₂=tr=5, λ₁λ₂=det=6 → λ=2, 3.
Asos: λ²−(tr A)λ+det A=0.

distractors.D: yig'indi $6$ ga, ko'paytma $5$ ga teng — iz va determinant almashtirilgan

distractors_ru.D: сумма $6$, произведение $5$ — след и определитель перепутаны

distractors_en.A: the product is $6$ but the sum is $7$
distractors_en.B: the sign of the sum is reversed
distractors_en.D: sum $6$, product $5$ — trace and determinant swapped
distractors_en.E: the sum is $5$ but the product is $-6$

question_en: For a $3\times3$ matrix, $\det A=4$. What is $\det(2A^{-1})$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. det(cA)=cⁿdet A, det A⁻¹=1/det A: 2³·(1/4)=2.
Asos: determinant xossalari.

uz: $n\times n$ matritsa uchun $\det(cA)=c^n\det A$ va $\det A^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{\det A}$: $$\det(2A^{-1})=2^3\cdot\frac{1}{4}=2$$
ru: Для матрицы $n\times n$: $\det(cA)=c^n\det A$ и $\det A^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{\det A}$: $$\det(2A^{-1})=2^3\cdot\frac{1}{4}=2$$
en: For an $n\times n$ matrix, $\det(cA)=c^n\det A$ and $\det A^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{\det A}$: $$\det(2A^{-1})=2^3\cdot\frac{1}{4}=2$$

distractors_en.A: forgot that the factor $2$ is cubed

distractors.C: ermit matritsaning xos qiymatlari haqiqiy bo'ladi

question_en: Which of the following matrices is Hermitian ($A^\dagger=A$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Diagonal haqiqiy, a₁₂=−i, a₂₁=i=(a₁₂)*.
Asos: A†=(Aᵀ)*, ermit ⇔ aⱼᵢ=aᵢⱼ*.

uz: Ermit matritsada diagonal haqiqiy va $a_{21}=a_{12}^*$. D da $a_{12}=-i$, $\ a_{21}=i=(-i)^*$: $$A^\dagger=\begin{pmatrix}2&-i\\i&3\end{pmatrix}=A$$
ru: У эрмитовой матрицы диагональ вещественна и $a_{21}=a_{12}^*$. В D: $a_{12}=-i$, $\ a_{21}=i=(-i)^*$: $$A^\dagger=\begin{pmatrix}2&-i\\i&3\end{pmatrix}=A$$
en: A Hermitian matrix has a real diagonal and $a_{21}=a_{12}^*$. In D, $a_{12}=-i$ and $a_{21}=i=(-i)^*$: $$A^\dagger=\begin{pmatrix}2&-i\\i&3\end{pmatrix}=A$$

distractors_en.C: a complex number $i$ on the diagonal

question_en: What is the commutator of the Pauli matrices $[\sigma_x,\sigma_z]$?
question_uz: Pauli matritsalari uchun kommutator $[\sigma_x,\sigma_z]$ nimaga teng?

uz: Siklik tartib $x\to y\to z\to x$: $[\sigma_z,\sigma_x]=2i\sigma_y$. Tartib almashsa, ishora o'zgaradi: $${[\sigma_x,\sigma_z]}=-2i\sigma_y=\begin{pmatrix}0&-2\\2&0\end{pmatrix}$$
ru: Циклический порядок $x\to y\to z\to x$: $[\sigma_z,\sigma_x]=2i\sigma_y$. При перестановке знак меняется: $${[\sigma_x,\sigma_z]}=-2i\sigma_y=\begin{pmatrix}0&-2\\2&0\end{pmatrix}$$
en: Cyclic order $x\to y\to z\to x$: $[\sigma_z,\sigma_x]=2i\sigma_y$. Swapping the order changes the sign: $${[\sigma_x,\sigma_z]}=-2i\sigma_y=\begin{pmatrix}0&-2\\2&0\end{pmatrix}$$

distractors_en.A: the order is not cyclic — the sign is reversed
distractors_en.E: this is the product $\sigma_z\sigma_x$, not the commutator

Asos: tr=2cosθ, det=1; Eyler formulasi.

explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Uchburchakli matritsaning xos qiymatlari — diagonalda.
Asos: det(A−λI)=(2−λ)(−1−λ)(4−λ).

uz: Uchburchakli matritsada $\det(A-\lambda I)$ — diagonal elementlar ko'paytmasi: $$(2-\lambda)(-1-\lambda)(4-\lambda)=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad\lambda=2,\ -1,\ 4$$
ru: Для треугольной матрицы $\det(A-\lambda I)$ — произведение диагональных элементов: $$(2-\lambda)(-1-\lambda)(4-\lambda)=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad\lambda=2,\ -1,\ 4$$
en: For a triangular matrix $\det(A-\lambda I)$ is the product of the diagonal entries: $$(2-\lambda)(-1-\lambda)(4-\lambda)=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad\lambda=2,\ -1,\ 4$$

question_en: Two identical masses $m$ are connected in series between two walls by three identical springs of stiffness $k$. What are the normal frequencies?
question_uz: Ikki bir xil $m$ massa devorlar orasida uchta bir xil $k$ bikrlikdagi prujina bilan ketma-ket bog'langan. Normal chastotalar qaysi?
question_ru: Две одинаковые массы $m$ соединены последовательно между стенками тремя одинаковыми пружинами жёсткости $k$. Каковы нормальные частоты?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. K=[[2k,−k],[−k,2k]] → mω²=2k∓k: ω=√(k/m), √(3k/m).
Asos: Ka=mω²a, λ=a±b.

distractors.B: ikki karrali chastota emas — modalar turlicha

distractors_en.A: $\sqrt{2k/m}$ is when one mass is held fixed
distractors_en.B: the frequency is not repeated — the modes differ
distractors_en.D: applied $\times$ instead of $\pm$ to the diagonal $2k$

question_en: Which matrix is the inverse of $\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\3&2\end{pmatrix}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. det=4−3=1; diagonalni almashtirib, qolganini ishorasini o'zgartiramiz.
Asos: 2×2 teskari matritsa formulasi.

distractors.C: elementlarni teskarisiga almashtirish — teskari matritsa emas

distractors_en.C: inverting entries is not the inverse matrix

question_en: A $2\times2$ matrix $A$ has eigenvalues $1$ and $2$. What is $\mathrm{tr}(A^3)$?
question_uz: $2\times2$ matritsa $A$ ning xos qiymatlari $1$ va $2$. $\mathrm{tr}(A^3)$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: Собственные значения матрицы $A$ $2\times2$ равны $1$ и $2$. Чему равен $\mathrm{tr}(A^3)$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. A³ ning xos qiymatlari 1³ va 2³; tr=1+8=9.
Asos: Av=λv ⇒ Aⁿv=λⁿv; iz = xos qiymatlar yig'indisi.

question_en: Which of the following numbers can be an eigenvalue of a unitary matrix?
question_uz: Quyidagi sonlardan qaysi biri unitar matritsaning xos qiymati bo'lishi mumkin?
question_ru: Какое из следующих чисел может быть собственным значением унитарной матрицы?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Unitar matritsa uzunlikni saqlaydi → |λ|=1; |(1+i)/√2|=1.
Asos: U†U=I ⇒ |λ|=1.

uz: $U\vec v=\lambda\vec v$ va $|U\vec v|=|\vec v|$ dan $|\lambda|=1$. Faqat C: $$\left|\frac{1+i}{\sqrt{2}}\right|=\frac{\sqrt{1+1}}{\sqrt{2}}=1$$
ru: Из $U\vec v=\lambda\vec v$ и $|U\vec v|=|\vec v|$ следует $|\lambda|=1$. Только C: $$\left|\frac{1+i}{\sqrt{2}}\right|=\frac{\sqrt{1+1}}{\sqrt{2}}=1$$
en: From $U\vec v=\lambda\vec v$ and $|U\vec v|=|\vec v|$ it follows that $|\lambda|=1$. Only C: $$\left|\frac{1+i}{\sqrt{2}}\right|=\frac{\sqrt{1+1}}{\sqrt{2}}=1$$

distractors_en.B: $\lambda=0$ — the matrix is singular, no inverse

question_en: In the two-level model of the ammonia molecule the Hamiltonian is $H=\begin{pmatrix}E_0&-A\\-A&E_0\end{pmatrix}$, $A>0$. What are the energy levels?
question_uz: Ammiak molekulasining ikki sathli modelida gamiltonian $H=\begin{pmatrix}E_0&-A\\-A&E_0\end{pmatrix}$, $A>0$. Energiya sathlari qaysi?
question_ru: В двухуровневой модели молекулы аммиака гамильтониан $H=\begin{pmatrix}E_0&-A\\-A&E_0\end{pmatrix}$, $A>0$. Каковы уровни энергии?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. [[a,b],[b,a]] ko'rinish: λ=a±b=E₀∓A.
Asos: energiya sathlari — H ning xos qiymatlari.

en: The form $\begin{pmatrix}a&b\\b&a\end{pmatrix}$ with $a=E_0$, $\ b=-A$: $$E=E_0\pm A,\qquad \Delta E=2A$$

distractors.B: bular matritsa elementlari, xos qiymatlar emas

distractors_ru.A: $2A$ — расстояние между уровнями, а не сдвиг
distractors_ru.B: это элементы матрицы, а не собственные значения

distractors_en.A: $2A$ is the level spacing, not the shift
distractors_en.B: these are matrix entries, not eigenvalues
